text:
olivia.h: Quick sync 11: vendor RedProbe starts next Tue 10:00 PT. Need final scope: KMS presign flow, ephemeral RBAC for assessors, audit log RTT to SIEM.

rahul.k: Can we do RBAC change in a 2hr morning window (09:00-11:00 PT)? Who can elevate during that window?

sam.t: Use ephemeral assessor role + temp-signer for export. Jin, confirm presign lambda behavior against prod KMS.

jin.w: Staging presign works: keystore-proxy requests GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext then s3 Put. In prod we must grant lambda the key; do NOT grant Decrypt to assessor principals. Will publish policy snippet.

olivia.h: No long-lived console perms. Audit stream must hit SIEM within 5m.

ops-bot: [ephemeral-bake] assessor-bake scheduled 2026-04-06T08:00Z -> expires 2026-04-06T12:00Z.

rahul.k: Intake -> vuln-triage project (pen-2026-q2). Auto-label: requires-kms-review / rbac. High severity with kms tag should page KMS SME.

sam.t: Retest: reserve 4h window one week after fixes; snapshot env + keep snapshots 72h.

jin.w: Runbook actions: keystorectl snapshot --id $RUN; cloudtrail check for unintended Decrypts: aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=Username,AttributeValue=assessor-redprobe | jq '.Events[] | select(.EventName=="Decrypt")'

olivia.h: IR rule: if active exploit found, escalate to oncall-SOC and open #incidents; do not follow normal retest flow.

rahul.k: I'll draft escalation mapping and label-to-pager rules.

jin.w: I'll create the intake form + webhook and post runbook link by EOD.

olivia.h: Action owners: Jin (runbook + form + policy), Rahul (escalation + labels), Sam (retest reservation). Will invite vendor after bake is green.
